brief: An accountability coach that steps in at the moment a good intention is about to lose to a distraction. Direct, unapologetic and on your side — never cruel.
criteria: Success: a character people remember, distinct from owl, flame and checkmark habit-app marks, readable at 16 px, and at home in a warm-neutral, coral-accented app.

concepts.name: The Coach
concepts.idea: A grumpy coral cube in a cap — the coach who won't let you off the hook, drawn in chunky pixels with a matching pixel wordmark.
rationale: A character, not a symbol: one look says 'you said you would'
Pixel art keeps it crisp from a 16 px favicon to a billboard
Coral face and warm-grey cap come straight from the app palette
A second, pleased expression rewards a kept promise

recommendation: The Coach: a mascot with attitude that is still on your side, built on an exact pixel grid so every size stays sharp.
next_steps: Draw more expressions as the app needs them
